front: What is a **reconstruction** in incomplete records?
back: Recovering missing figures (credit sales, purchases, expenses, drawings, opening capital) step by step from the surviving information.

front: Order of work: final accounts from incomplete records
back: Opening statement of affairs, total accounts, bank summary, expenses, adjustments, then the statements and a balance check.
Cash paid + opening prepayment + closing accrual - opening accrual - closing prepayment.

front: Purchase of equipment in the year
back: Add to the cost of non-current assets and depreciate; it is not an expense.

front: Opening current account of the last partner
back: Opening net assets less the capital accounts and the other partners' current accounts.

front: Closing current account of a partner
back: Opening balance + salary + interest on capital + share of residual - interest on drawings - drawings.

front: Why can the statement of financial position balance yet be wrong?
back: Balancing figures such as drawings absorb omitted items, so profit and drawings may both be misstated.
Profit for the year, then salaries and interest on capital, then the residual shared in the profit-sharing ratio.
An expense of the business, charged before profit for the year; not an appropriation.
